summary: Tokyo, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Moscow and Hong Kong come fast; New York (#17), London (#20) and Paris (#11) are the famous traps, and Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Chengdu are the surprises.
reasons: Builder's own replay, pending a real judge. A casual found 7 and lost lives on New York, London, Paris, Mexico City and Singapore, each showing its riders a year.

Answered as cities; system names work too (tokyo metro, toei, mtr, beijing subway, moscow metro). A city with two systems counts its busiest (Tokyo Metro, not Toei). Generic system names (red line, skyline) name nothing.
203 cities with a figure and every big city an answer: a casual Blitz scored 34 of 34.
fixes: Figures are each system's latest year (2023 to 2025), as the page gives them.
"skytrain" costs a life as Vancouver's SkyTrain (#95); Bangkok's BTS Skytrain (#63) is typed "bts skytrain".
